cold_selection: Conservative first-observed capture-role keys, including target row/copy order and per-owner effective pair widths/step/tail roles. No duration threshold. No actual hit/miss flag exists. All cold windows retained.
limitations: Packing precedes window_enter in corrected S32 patch; enter->packed marker span is not packing duration.
CPU wait spans may contain queue/device waiting. Low CPU span does not prove GPU-idle absence or exclude host contribution to a previous unitrace gap.
Slot-copy begin/end captures the existing wrapper including a standalone draft if pair coordinator is absent; pair-only selection avoids that attribution ambiguity.
No GPU events or saved latency are derived from these markers.
No footer/thread IDs exist; positive records require explicit enter/end and unique monotone IDs, but external root teardown evidence remains required.
Source-equivalence evidence concerns retained work/call ordering; timestamp/buffer overhead may perturb CPU scheduling.
